#### `GET /api/v1/habits`

#### `POST /api/v1/habits`

Create Habit

- Auth: Bearer required
- Client: `createHabit`

Request body (`createHabitInputSchema`):

- `name`: string 1–120

- `targetCount`: number int min 1 max 99 (optional)
- `windowStart`: string pattern (optional)
- `windowEnd`: string pattern (optional)
- `outcomeId`: uuid (optional)
